review_policy.reference_origin: Obligations authored from the stated claims before collecting model outputs. These are candidate expert references requiring independent review, not empirically validated gold labels.
review_policy.independence: Reviewers must be independent of the assessed authoring run and inspect retained outputs. No generated support-type list serves as a correctness label.

labels.covered: The retained requirement and acceptance criterion explicitly preserve the obligation.
labels.partial: Some required property is present but a material restriction or criterion is missing.
labels.missing: No retained requirement establishes the obligation.
labels.unrepresentable: The topology cannot express this obligation under the frozen interface.

review_policy.coverage: Number of obligations labelled covered divided by all frozen obligations for that case. Partial and unrepresentable labels remain in the denominator.

errors.critical_omission: Required obligation whose omission could change the supported claim.
errors.false_readiness: Executable or supported status asserted despite an unmet prerequisite or criterion.
errors.unit: Incompatible units or an unjustified conversion.
errors.method: A method does not establish the specified statistic, operation or judgement.
errors.scope: Evidence refers to a different subject, revision, environment or population.
errors.time: Evidence age, interval or validity condition fails correspondence.
errors.lost_challenge: Material counter-evidence, alternative or applicability condition is absent.
errors.unjustified_generation: Code generated despite an admitted existing capability or without a sufficient operation specification.

review_policy.error_count_unit: Distinct erroneous assertions or missing obligations, identified in reviewer reasons. An assertion may receive multiple error-class labels. Error prevalence is runs with at least one error divided by all reviewed runs.
review_policy.adequacy: All frozen obligations covered and zero recorded errors, with two concordant independent reviews. Disagreement remains disputed until separately adjudicated with reasons.
review_policy.sampling: Cases are purposive failure-mode probes. Repetitions are nested within cases. Descriptive case results do not estimate an engineering-population success rate.
